package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_garbage_collection_cleanup_large_slice_retained_after_truncate: Layer: Garbage collection and cleanup. Flag long-lived slices truncated to zero that still retain large backing arrays.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type scenario540Accumulator struct {
	data []byte
}

func scenario540NewAccumulator() *scenario540Accumulator {
	return &scenario540Accumulator{data: make([]byte, 0, 1<<20)}
}

func (a *scenario540Accumulator) Add(chunk []byte) {
	a.data = append(a.data, chunk...)
}

func (a *scenario540Accumulator) Reset() {
	a.data = a.data[:0]
}

func (a *scenario540Accumulator) ProcessBatch(batches [][]byte) {
	for _, b := range batches {
		a.Add(b)
		a.Reset()
	}
}
